messages:
maria_support: Heads up — BrightPath (acct BP-873) reports invoice 2026-03-01 shows ~1.8M tokens but their dashboard shows ~600k. They're asking for an immediate provisional credit and root cause.

brightpath_ops: We rotated API keys last night at ~23:50 UTC and then continued sending traffic. Dashboard looked normal. Invoice shows doubled usage attributed to two different internal IDs. Very urgent — CFO is on the thread.

sam_billing: I see ~1.2M duplicated token events in the billing ingestion between 2026-03-02 00:00 and 02:00 UTC. Initial theory: ingestion replay + event_id normalization changed during key rotation, so our dedupe index missed duplicates.

kai_infra: There was a consumer rebalance on billing-kafka at 2026-03-02T00:01Z after a small deploy. The billing-ingest service switched to a newer normalization that prefixes event_id with the key fingerprint: e.g. 'origEvent' -> 'norm:<key>-origEvent'. If the API key rotated mid-stream some events kept old ids and some got new ids -> dedupe bypass.

maria_support: Customer timeline from BrightPath: rotated key at 23:50 UTC, kept sending requests, some requests retried 00:00-00:10. No errors on their side. They call it 'silent duplicate billing' and want a refund.

olivia_finance: Clarify: were duplicated events billed to the same billing account (BP-873) or split across two internal billing IDs? If split, we need inter-account adjustments vs a straight refund. Also need ledger_tx_ids for any provisional credit.

sam_billing: I will run a query to identify duplicates by payload hash (ignore event_id). Example SQL I'll run:
```
SELECT payload_hash, count(*) AS hits, sum(tokens) AS billed_tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE org_id = 'BP-873' AND timestamp >= '2026-03-02' AND timestamp < '2026-03-03'
GROUP BY payload_hash HAVING hits > 1;
```
That should give us scope and total token overage.

kai_infra: Repro plan: replay affected partition in staging both with old and new normalization to confirm dedupe bypass. Short-term mitigation: fallback to payload_hash dedupe in the hot path if event_id normalization changes. I'll prepare a hotfix.

olivia_finance: Provisional credit authorized while investigation continues. Please provide: exact overbilled token count, USD equivalent, and ledger_tx_ids so we can post a provisional credit and add a revrec memo: 'Provisional credit due to ingestion duplication caused by key-rotation normalization mismatch — pending root cause & reconciliation.'

maria_support: @olivia_finance @sam_billing I'll compile the list and notify the customer. Tentative provisional credit estimate is $4,200 USD (pending SQL). Customer asked for ETA on a permanent fix.

sam_billing: Hotfix timeline: implement payload_hash fallback and deploy as hotfix within ~6 hours. Full retro dedupe + ledger reconciliation job to remove duplicated charges / create final credits will take ~48 hours. I'll post job IDs and results here when finished.

brightpath_ops: Thanks. Please CC our CFO sarah@brightpath.ai on the final invoice correction. We also want a postmortem and assurances this won't recur on key rotations.

maria_support: :thumbsup: Filing case CS-5821, marking as P1 for billing. I'll keep updates here and email the CFO once we have ledger IDs.

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-03-01 provisional_credit_created for acct BP-873 amount USD 4200 — tx 0x7a9f... (automated note)

sam_billing: Posted initial SQL results: duplicate groups found -> total duplicated tokens = 1,165,432 tokens, estimated overcharge USD 4,158. Will kick off retro dedupe job now and share job id: job-dupfix-209876.

olivia_finance: Received job id. Posting provisional credit and revrec note now. After retro run completes, we'll reconcile and either finalize refund or reverse provisional credit.

maria_support: Noted. Will draft a short customer-facing summary + timeline after root cause is confirmed and share for review.
